answer: Sybil resistance follows from reputation’s exponential temporal decay: with a fixed half-life, trust fades unless honest service is sustained. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned identity has almost no incoming, reciprocity-weighted support, so its eigenvector centrality remains near zero; cloning accounts cannot create trusted paths or sufficient consensus weight. Even peers named violet, willow, and nectar must build durable, reciprocal evidence before their endorsements can matter.
